verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm Modal serves a live llms.txt at modal.com/llms.txt and markdown versions of its docs, such as /docs/guide/sandboxes.md. Many other doc pages are also published as .md URLs (SDK reference, examples, release notes), so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-readable documentation. Missing for 10: first-party guidance describing how agents should consume llms.txt or the .md docs, and any evidence of a fuller companion index such as llms-full.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://modal.com/llms.txt # Modal Documentation
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://modal.com/docs/guide/sandboxes.md # Sandboxes
A `Sandbox` object lets you interact with a running sandbox. This API is similar to Python's asyncio.subprocess.Process
